machine: STE, 68000, 8 MHz, 1 MiB, RGB PAL, German TOS 1.62
method: HRDB measured N-key off/on cycle. Only ASM renderer and TV command update; Screen_Update/VBL/input excluded. Palette swap, scene preparation/Memory_Copy/font calls are outside these address ranges. This is an average over transition frames, not a worst-case bound.
